title: 4-bit Counter
description:
Design a 4-bit up counter with enable and active-high asynchronous reset.

Required module:
module counter_4bit(input clk, input reset, input enable, output reg [3:0] count);

Behavior:
- When reset is 1, count becomes 0000 immediately
- On each rising edge of clk, if enable is 1, count increments by 1
- If enable is 0, count holds its value
